jurisdictionQuote: The Holt Fire District referendum will appear ONLY for part of Precinct 3 and all of Precinct 4.

whatItDoes: Shall Holt Fire District impose revised fire impact fee rates, effective October 1, 2027, in the amount of $1.00 per square foot of heated and cooled area for new residential construction and $2.00 per square foot of gross floor area for new non-residential construction?
Holt Fire District currently imposes fire impact fees on new construction.
